subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit host-path remapping contract for Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox managed mounts, or keep the current documented requirement that Gateway-visible paths must also exist on the Docker host?
rationale: Both choices affect sandbox bind-source trust boundaries and operator setup compatibility; automation should not choose the permanent host-path exposure contract without maintainer security/product intent.

options.title: Define secure remapping contract
options.body: Add or sponsor a validated mapping for managed workspace and skill mounts, update docs/config/schema as needed, and require live Docker Gateway/DooD proof before closing the cluster.

options.title: Keep identical-path contract
options.body: Document the identical host/container path requirement as the supported Docker sandbox contract and close only after users have a clear migration or doctor warning path.

options.title: Land only narrow skill fix
options.body: Treat the open materialized-skills PR as a narrow partial fix while leaving this canonical workspaceAccess issue open for the broader managed mount contract.

recommendation.title: Define secure remapping contract
recommendation.body: Add or sponsor a validated mapping for managed workspace and skill mounts, update docs/config/schema as needed, and require live Docker Gateway/DooD proof before closing the cluster.

likelyOwner.reason: They marked this issue canonical for the cluster and have recent sandbox/Docker-path history relevant to the boundary decision.
